recs.stt: Computer security is broken, but things are starting to improve
recs.x:
lways have failure modes where minor errors in code can result in critical vulnerabilities and privilege escalation. I love what OpenBSD is doing with pledges[0] and hope to see this gain traction in other operating systems. Here is a good overview of Pledge[1] by Theo de Raadt. Unfortunately for Linux ecosystem, the Kernel does not include any standard libs for developers, so this type of security mitigation will take a long time to arrive. But for Unix based operating systems we should expect this much sooner.
